title: Putin attends launch of Moscow Metro’s new line as one station displays ‘special military operation’ imagery — Meduza
text:
Moscow’s new Bulvar Generala Karbysheva metro station features panels mentioning the “special military operation.”

Above the stairs at one of the station’s exits is an inscription reading “Engineer Troops,” with “Special Military Operation” below it.

Inside the station, wall bas-reliefs feature the abbreviation “SVO,” an “Honorary Specialist of the Engineer Troops” badge, and images of drones, military equipment, and uniforms.

The first section of the Moscow Metro’s new Rublyovo-Arkhangelskaya Line — the system’s 17th line — opened on September 5. Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin and Vladimir Putin took part in the launch ceremony.

The section includes five stations: Delovoy Tsentr and Shelepikha, which were previously part of the Big Circle Line, as well as Zvenigorodskaya, Narodnoye Opolcheniye, and Bulvar Generala Karbysheva.
